Bugles, the first cone-shaped corn snack

Contains: 3 oz
features:
Features:

Unique Cone Shape

Iconic Bugles shape that's fun to eat and great for dipping or stacking.

Spicy Tabasco Flavor

Coated with bold, tangy Tabasco seasoning for a zesty, peppery kick.

Crispy Texture

Made from cornmeal and fried to a light, airy crunch.

Snack-Size Convenience

Available in multiple sizes, ideal for sharing, lunchboxes, or solo snacking.

Peanut-Free

Manufactured in a facility without peanuts (though may contain milk or wheat).

Benefits:

Exciting Flavor Experience

Combines the nostalgia of classic Bugles with a spicy twist, appealing to spice lovers.

Perfect for Parties or On-the-Go

Easy to pack, share, and serve at gatherings or as an everyday snack.

Nostalgic Enjoyment

Brings back childhood memories while introducing a bold, modern flavor.

Ready-to-Eat

No prep needed — a fast, satisfying snack straight from the bag.
ingredients: Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Coconut Oil, Sugar. Contains 2% or less of: Corn Maltodextrin, Salt, Whey Powder, Monosodium Glutamate, Natural Flavor, Distilled Monoglycerides, Baking Soda, Garlic Powder, Color (paprika extract, turmeric extract), Spice, Malic Acid, TABASCO® Brand Flavoring (red pepper, distilled vinegar, salt), Sunflower Oil, Dried Buttermilk, Palm Oil, Yeast Extract, TABASCO® Brand Seasoning (TABASCO® Brand Pepper Sauce [distilled vinegar, red pepper, salt], maltodextrin), Onion Powder. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
